_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
description: What level should be the goal for the slot.
This level will be unlocked upon recieving the required amount of Star Medals.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Controls the percentage of Star Medals in the item pool that will be required to goal.
Enables locations and items related to Special Worlds.

golden_flagpoles.description: Adds locations for reaching the top of the flagpole at the end of each level.

description: Adds locations for completing the 35 random Mystery Boxes that can be found on the world map.
These will require an unlock through a 'Progressive Mystery Boxes' item in the multiworld, as well as access to any of the worlds where the respective rooms can show up.
Enables locking certain levels based on Star Medal count, as is done in the vanilla game (e.g. World 1-4 being locked behind 3 Star Medals).
NOTE: This will not affect your chosen goal level.
